verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Retell has API reference pages, such as the clone-voice endpoint page that documents its parameters. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or live request execution. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so a static reference page is an adjacent feature, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
